question: give district wise ANC percentage-point increase between 2021 and 2023 only Gaya and Nalanda
gold_sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT district, year, 100.0 * anc4_completed / pregnancies_registered AS rate FROM anc_visits WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2021, 2023)) SELECT district, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN rate END), 1) AS change_pp FROM rates GROUP BY district ORDER BY district
sql_duckdb: WITH base AS (SELECT district, year, pregnancies_registered, anc4_completed, NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0) AS denom FROM anc_visits WHERE year IN (2021, 2023) AND district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda')), pct AS (SELECT district, MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN anc4_completed / NULLIF(denom, 0) * 100 END) AS pct_2021, MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN anc4_completed / NULLIF(denom, 0) * 100 END) AS pct_2023 FROM base GROUP BY district) SELECT district, pct_2023 - pct_2021 AS percentage_point_increase FROM pct

CURRENT QUESTION:
give district wise ANC percentage-point increase between 2021 and 2023 only Gaya and Nalanda
attempts.response:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    district,
    year,
    pregnancies_registered,
    anc4_completed,
    NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0) AS denom
  FROM anc_visits
  WHERE year IN (2021, 2023)
    AND district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda')
),
pct AS (
  SELECT
    district,
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN anc4_completed / denom * 100 END) AS pct_2021,
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN anc4_completed / denom * 100 END) AS pct_2023
  FROM base
  GROUP BY district
)
SELECT
  district,
  pct_2023 - pct_2021 AS percentage_point_increase
FROM pct;
